product.storySubtitle: Scroll down: this is exactly what your customers experience.
storySteps: Your customer brings their phone close

faq.q: Do my customers need an app?
faq.a: No. They simply bring their phone close and the page opens straight in the browser. Works with iPhone (XR, XS and newer) and NFC-enabled Android phones. Stands also carry a QR code for every other phone.

faq.q: Can I change the link later?
faq.a: Yes, at any time. Every product carries a permanent smart link (onde.tn/t/…). The chip never changes: we update the destination remotely, in seconds. Google reviews today, your menu or Instagram tomorrow — nothing to reprint.

faq.q: How do I find my Google review link?
faq.a: In Google Maps or Google Business Profile, open your listing and tap “Ask for reviews”: Google gives you a short link to copy. Can't find it? We'll get it with you on the confirmation call.

faq.q: How much is delivery, and how long does it take?
faq.a: {fee} anywhere in Tunisia, and free from {threshold}. We call you to confirm the order, then deliver within 3 days.
You pay cash on delivery. Nothing to pay online.
After your first delivered order, your next order automatically gets −{pct}% (one time). We recognise you by your phone number — no code to remember.
Of course. The “Order on WhatsApp” button prepares a message with your selection: all you have to do is send it.
